_comment: Intervention catalogue (PHASE2_SPEC §6.1). Each intervention is a geometry operation the engine applies to a copy of the design and measures by a partial re-run. It keeps the fields of the old recommendation templates. Sizes and intensities have basis records (interventions.*). 'literature' is context only and is never attached to the site as a number.

I1.title: Plant shade trees on the paving or along its edges
I1.intervention: Plant trees in a regular grid across the hotspot, keeping clear of building façades.
I1.expected_direction: Removes sun from the paving under and beside each canopy; measured below as the change in sun-exposed area-hours.
required_inputs: Tree species and mature canopy size
tradeoffs: Irrigation water (litres/day per tree: value required)
Years until the canopy reaches the modelled size
May take parking or circulation space
I1.evaluation_method: Measured: the trees are added to a copy of the design and the shade, heat-stress and hotspot analyses are re-run; the change is the hotspot's sun-exposed area-hours at very strong heat stress.

literature.text: Urban forests average about 1.6 °C cooler by day than their surroundings
Tree shade lowers the radiant heat a pedestrian feels

I2.title: Add shade structures
I2.intervention: Cover part or all of the hotspot with shade structures (canopies, pergolas, colonnades).
I2.expected_direction: Shades the covered ground; measured below as the change in sun-exposed area-hours.
I2.evaluation_method: Measured: the structures are added to a copy of the design and the shade, heat-stress and hotspot analyses are re-run.

literature.text: Shade lowers the radiant heat a pedestrian feels

I3.title: Convert part of the paving to planting
I3.intervention: Re-type part of the paved surface in the hotspot to planted ground, keeping access routes.
I3.expected_direction: Reduces the sun-exposed hard surface and raises the green share; measured below.
required_inputs: Areas that are not needed for access or parking
tradeoffs: Irrigation water (litres/day per m²: value required)
I3.evaluation_method: Measured: the paving is re-typed to planting in a copy of the design and the analyses are re-run.

literature.text: Parks average about 0.94 °C cooler by day than their surroundings

I4.title: Cool (high-albedo) paving
I4.intervention: Re-surface the paving in the hotspot with a high-reflectance material.
I4.expected_direction: Lowers the paving's surface temperature; its effect on the heat a pedestrian feels is NOT modelled and can be negative (reflected sunlight).
tradeoffs: May raise the radiant heat a pedestrian feels (reflected sunlight) [R-14, R-28]
Reflectance falls as the surface gets dirty
I4.evaluation_method: Area treated only; reported separately and never ranked against shade, because the engine does not model surface temperature or reflected radiation.

literature.text: Reflective paving can raise the mean radiant temperature pedestrians feel

I5.title: Reduce or reconfigure parking
I5.intervention: Remove part of the surface parking in the hotspot, leaving the freed ground unpaved.
I5.expected_direction: Reduces the sun-exposed hard surface; measured below.
I5.evaluation_method: Measured: the parking is reduced in a copy of the design and the analyses are re-run.

I6.title: Fix the planning violation
I6.intervention: Trim building parts out of the setback band, or convert paving to green space until the verified minimum is met.
I6.expected_direction: Removes the shortfall so that the verified rule check passes; measured below.
required_inputs: Design changes acceptable to the client
tradeoffs: Lost built area or paved area
Irrigation water for added green (value required)
I6.evaluation_method: Measured: the change is applied to a copy of the design and the urban-form and planning checks are re-run.

I7.title: Review street orientation and spacing
I7.intervention: Review the street axis and building heights along exposed east–west streets (rotate or shift blocks, or raise the edges).
I7.expected_direction: A redesign may add building shade on the street; not generated automatically in this version.
tradeoffs: Daylight and solar access to buildings
I7.evaluation_method: Check only: the street axis and height-to-width ratio are reported with the street's sun-exposed area-hours; model a revised layout as an alternative to measure it.
